summary: Collision response with random perturbation. Saves/restores the state activation flag, reads the current position components from this+0x90/+0x94/+0x98, draws three random values from UtilityFunction_6010 and reduces each to a sign multiplier of +1.0 or -1.0 (mask 0x80000001 with an evenness test), scales by a2 * a3 * 0.5 clamped at 0.5, accumulates the perturbed vector into the local components, and writes the result back through VectorCopy. Invoked by CameraShake.

local_names.v15: perturbation magnitude a2 * a3 * 0.5, clamped to 0.5

operations.description: StateActivatedPositionSaveRestore(1) saves/restores the state activation flag around the position update.
Read the current position: v19 = *(float*)(this + 144) (this+0x90), v20 = *(float*)(this + 148) (this+0x94), v21 = *(float*)(this + 152) (this+0x98).

Three calls to UtilityFunction_6010() draw random values; each is masked with 0x80000001 and tested for evenness of its low bit via the ((v - 1) | 0xFFFFFFFE) == -1 idiom to choose +1.0 or -1.0 as the sign multiplier for X, Y and Z.
v15 = a2 * a3 * 0.5, clamped down to 0.5 when it exceeds 0.5.
Perturb each component: v19 += v17 * v15 * a3; v20 += v18 * v15 * a3; v21 += v15 * v14 * a3.
VectorCopy(this, &v19) writes the computed perturbed vector into the object.
Return the VectorCopy result (the object pointer).
Invoked by CameraShake (0x0040ADB0) as a collision response helper; the ABI name Collision_Response_with_Random_Perturbation is recorded as LEGACY.
